newsitem.title: HONG KONG: MAS to revamp regional routes with new Boeing 777s.
newsitem.headline: MAS to revamp regional routes with new Boeing 777s.

text.p: Malaysia Airlines System Bhd (MAS) is to introduce new Boeing 777 aircraft on its services between Kuala Lumpur and Hong Kong later this year, an airline spokeswoman said.
The 278 seat twinjets will replace Boeing 747, Airbus A330 and McDonnell Douglas MD-11 currently used which are due to be phased out or returned to their lessors.

The first four of 11 777-200 aircraft are due to be delivered between April and July. It's expected they will begin flying into Hong Kong as well as other regional destinations between June and August, MAS said. It currently flies 14 times a week between the Malaysian capital and Hong Kong.

The airline said the changes are part of a rationalisation programme of its aircraft fleet which is expected to allow increased frequencies to its European destinations and expanded capacity on regional routes. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
